one key for every hover plate  |  rebuil
LIT / DIM
lit = what the card touches, at full val
Dim = everything else: value x0.40, chro
x0.45. Cards not in play 70 percent; UND
SEND IT, nameplate 62.
FOCUS: FOUR CORNERS
FOCUS #D4FF00, four separate corners wit
px legs, never joined, never a full outl
2 px = a legal target, 3.5 px = the aime
one.
PLAN ARROW (L5)
PLAN yellow arrowed outline in wax: two
edges on a dark channel, chevrons every
px, a filled head. Movement only.
PENCIL (L6)
7 px wax, 3 px ink edge, wax grain, no g
A closed ring round a number the plan
changes; an underline under the YOU segm
that change.
GHOST
the sim plan unit at its new place at 74
percent, a pencil outline outside its ce
its plan landing arc. The origin cell is
veiled.
HATCH
HP lost at THIS END TURN, in the cause
colour: pink = ours, red = the enemy hit
you, indigo = your soak.
LIFTED CARD
1.10x on its pink print. The fan slides
clear: outside r459, 3 px off landings,
sibling cost and rules, 2 px off UNDO /
IT; no resting card hides more than at r
HIT BURST
pink comic starburst = a hit that lands
unit. It marks a cell or an edge, never
icon.
OPTION ROWS
a card with options splits NEXT into one
per option. The hovered row gets a neutr
edge, the best one a neutral star. No PL
yellow.
RAM: ONE TREATMENT
the RAM row shows the plan in its own co
states (spent, refunded). No pencil or r
on a coin, no box on a TRACE pip.
